name: Fotogenic AI – Product Image Generator for WooCommerce
author: fotogenicai

sections.description:
Fotogenic AI adds an AI Photography Studio inside wp-admin for WooCommerce teams that need consistent product photos, catalog refreshes, and faster visual production.

Instead of spending time writing instructions in different AI tools, testing random results, and updating products by hand, Fotogenic AI gives you one clear workflow built around guided selections.

In e-commerce, buyers often decide in seconds. Your product images help capture attention, shape first impressions, and influence whether a shopper keeps looking or moves on. Better visuals can make listings feel more trustworthy, more polished, and easier to buy from.

Use the images you already have, generate new product visuals, review the results, and apply approved changes to your catalog in one place.

Built for real e-commerce work

Online stores need more than just AI image generation.

They need a practical way to:

  • Improve product presentation
  • Refresh old listings
  • Create more consistent visuals across the catalog
  • Update many products faster
  • Review changes before applying them

Fotogenic AI is built for that kind of work.

It helps turn existing product photos into new visuals through a guided workflow that is easier to manage and easier to repeat.

Great for

  • WooCommerce store owners
  • E-commerce teams
  • Agencies managing product catalogs
  • Brands that want faster image production inside WordPress

Features

Generate images for one product

Improve or refresh a single product listing when you need better visuals for one item. Choose from a variety of settings for broad customization, or let Fotogenic Visual Intelligence help shape the best presentation for your product.

Generate images for many products at once

Use bulk workflows to generate images for multiple WooCommerce products and manage the results in one place.

Bulk selection supports:

  • Search by product name, SKU, or ID
  • Category filters
  • Stock status filters
  • Multi-item selection for larger runs

Choose which product images to use

Start with the product images you already have. For better final result include additional references from gallery.

Review results before changing your store

Fotogenic AI bulk workflows are built around efficiency, review and approval. You can:

  • Handle ready items in bulk
  • Pause or stop active bulk jobs
  • Run jobs in the background
  • Review generated images
  • Accept or decline each result
  • Choose how approved images should be used

Decide how approved images are applied

When you approve a result, you can choose to:

  • Add it to the gallery
  • Replace the main product image
  • Replace the main product image and also add it to the gallery

Simple 3-step workflow

  1. Choose assets
    Select a target such as Product, Product Bulk, Media Library, Post, or Page.
  2. Set the visual direction
    Choose different scene options, add a model, or attach inspiration you found online. You can also let Fotogenic Visual Intelligence help shape the scene automatically.
  3. Review the results
    Approve the images you like the most, decline the ones you do not, and apply approved changes to your catalog.

Made for recurring workflows

Fotogenic AI helps bring more order to product image creation by giving you a variety of options to choose from:

  • Presets for repeated workflows
  • Saved default instructions
  • Global instructions for consistency across runs
  • Custom instructions for small adjustments

This makes it easier to create a more consistent visual style across many products rather than starting from zero every time.

Pricing

To view current plans, credits, and pricing details, visit our Pricing page.

More Information

https://fotogenic.ai/
sections.installation:
How to install Fotogenic AI:

  1. Upload the fotogenic-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Fotogenic AI -> Settings.
  4. Log in to your Fotogenic AI account.
  5. Open Fotogenic AI -> Studio and start your first workflow.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin add anything to my site’s front-end?

No. Fotogenic AI runs in wp-admin only. It does not add any frontend blocks, shortcodes, widgets, or tracking scripts.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is required only for Product and Product Bulk targets. Media Library, Post, and Page targets do not require WooCommerce.

Can I generate images for many products at once?

Yes. Fotogenic AI supports bulk workflows for WooCommerce products, so you can select multiple items, generate results, review them, and apply approved updates.

Can I review results before anything changes?

Yes. The workflow is built around review and approval. You decide what to accept, what to decline, and how approved images should be applied.

Can I control where approved images go?

Yes. You can choose whether approved images should be added to the gallery, replace the main product image, or do both.

Does the plugin work without a Fotogenic AI account?

The screens can load without a connected account and settings can still be adjusted, but image-generation actions require a connected Fotogenic AI account.

Do I need credits or paid service access?

Generation availability depends on your Fotogenic AI account status and available credits or service access.

screenshots.caption: Launch your WooCommerce image workflow from one clean control center. Connect your Fotogenic AI account, set store-wide generation instructions, and keep your catalog photography standards consistent before you generate at scale.

Run bulk WooCommerce product image generation and review approved results product by product. Replace ordinary catalog shots with polished lifestyle visuals and push stronger imagery into your product galleries faster.

Track live bulk progress while products move through generation, approval, and gallery updates. Scale WooCommerce photography across multiple SKUs without losing control over quality, pacing, or final selection.

Select multiple WooCommerce products by category, stock status, and source image strategy in a single workflow. Apply presets, global instructions, and visual rules once, then generate consistent storefront imagery across your catalog.

Create premium product photography for a single WooCommerce item directly inside WordPress. Start with your current product image, tune the visual direction, and generate campaign-ready results without leaving wp-admin.

Turn a standard WooCommerce product shot into premium lifestyle imagery that feels ready for a homepage banner, campaign, or high-converting product page. Fotogenic AI helps stores upgrade basic packshots into branded visual merchandising.

Generate multiple on-brand angles and polished compositions from the same WooCommerce product to build richer galleries and stronger PDPs. Give shoppers more reasons to trust the product, explore the details, and convert.

Create editorial-style WooCommerce product visuals that make your catalog look more premium and more consistent at scale. Move faster from raw product shots to conversion-ready photography for storefronts, ads, and launches.
